coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing chi, fixed polarisation scenario
notes: Paper recasts ORGAN Phase 1a axion-photon limit (|g_agg|<=3e-12 over 63.2-67.1 ueV) into dark photon, scalar/dilaton, and QEMD gaAB limits. Primary new result highlighted is dark photon kinetic mixing chi over 60-80 ueV range, strictest to date between 63.2-65.1 ueV. Dark photon values are approximate readings from Fig.1 for the fixed-polarisation scenario; random polarisation would be somewhat lower (better) by factor ~sqrt(0.03/0.333)~0.3, i.e. chi~1.4e-13. Exact numbers not tabulated in text so data points are approximate estimates from the figure axis (10^-13 to 10^-12 band). Also constrains scalar dilaton g_phigg (~1e-9 to 1e-7 GeV^-1 over 50-300 ueV, not surpassing CAST) and equivalent gaAB. Coupling type could alternatively be recorded as ScalarPhoton/AxionPhoton for those secondary results; dark photon is the headline new limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.55, 5))
